new_engines.capacity_simulation: Queueing / discrete-event simulation of ED, inpatient and OR flow for what-if capacity questions (arrival curves, service times, boarding).
new_engines.flow_decomposition: Stage-level interval decomposition of patient flow (door-to-X, LOS by stage) with bottleneck attribution and censoring-aware percentiles.
new_engines.or_block_optimization: OR block allocation / release optimisation from case-duration distributions and block utilisation.
new_engines.staffing_optimization: Shift-level staffing optimisation against forecast census/acuity with ratio and labour-cost constraints.
new_engines.risk_standardized_outcomes: CMS-style hierarchical risk-standardised mortality/readmission (O/E, ERR, RSMR) with penalty simulation.
new_engines.bundle_compliance: Time-anchored all-or-none care-bundle evaluation (SEP-1, stroke door-to-needle, VTE prophylaxis) with element-level failure reasons.
new_engines.hai_surveillance: NHSN case-definition engine for HAIs with device days and standardised infection ratios (SIR).
new_engines.antimicrobial_use_metrics: Days of therapy per 1,000 days present, spectrum indices and SAAR-like benchmarking.
new_engines.denial_prediction: Pre-submission claim-level denial risk scoring with reason attribution.
new_engines.contract_reimbursement: Expected reimbursement from payer contract terms; variance (underpayment) by claim and term.
new_engines.cdi_opportunity: DRG / CC-MCC documentation-opportunity model (expected vs coded severity) for CDI targeting.
new_engines.price_transparency_benchmark: Parse machine-readable price files and compare negotiated rates across payers/competitors.
new_engines.prior_auth_rules: Prior-auth rule analytics: approval-rate thresholds, gold-carding and auto-approval candidates by service/provider.
new_engines.mlr_calculation: Medical loss ratio with credibility adjustment and rebate estimation.
new_engines.network_adequacy: Geospatial time/distance and provider-to-member ratio checks against adequacy standards.
new_engines.provider_network_graph: Referral/billing network graph analytics for collusion, kickback and patient-steering patterns.
new_engines.eligibility_340b: 340B eligibility determination and split-billing / duplicate-discount compliance rules.
new_engines.ddi_screening: Concurrent-medication interaction screening against an interaction knowledge base with severity.
new_engines.target_trial_emulation: Comparative effectiveness via target-trial emulation (new-user active-comparator, propensity/IPTW, negative controls).
new_engines.line_of_therapy: Rule-based line-of-therapy derivation from administrations/dispenses (regimen window, gaps, switches).
new_engines.trial_feasibility: Computable eligibility funnel for trial criteria with site ranking and diversity breakdown.
new_engines.spatiotemporal_cluster: Space-time scan statistics for outbreak / syndromic cluster detection.
new_engines.survey_adjustment: Survey analytics with patient-mix/mode adjustment, top-box scoring and key-driver analysis.
new_engines.diagnostic_delay_lookback: SPADE-style look-back/look-forward for missed diagnostic opportunities.
new_engines.cql_rule_engine: Generic computable-guideline (CQL) rule execution for guideline adherence beyond the VBC measure library.
